task: The experiment "guest_checkout_copy test" in Production is set up but not running. Start it.
finalText:
DONE? No. I did not start the experiment, because the task doesn't say what traffic percentage to use, and Production is live.

Here is what I found:

- `guest_checkout_copy` (feature 795) is enabled in Production (environment 407).
- It is a multivariate feature whose only variant, "Try it free" (key `b`, variant id 79), has weight 0%. That 0% allocation is why it isn't running; the control is the default value "Start free trial".
- Development shows the same 0% weight, so there is no existing target percentage to copy.

To start it I would set variant `b`'s weight in Production to a value you choose, for example `flagsmith feature variant update guest_checkout_copy b --weight <N> -e [env-13ffd0be931283df]`. Tell me the percentage and I'll apply it.
